# lc.gravity-hold-rom

Kind: load_case. Status: **proposed** (PROPOSED: not yet accepted).

Each limited joint swept through its range against gravity, one at a time, with the other joints at the reference pose and the pelvis held by the gantry.

Notes: Not an impact or other contact transient: the loads come from rigid-body inverse dynamics at zero velocity on a gantry that holds the pelvis (no contact solver), so the simulation's physics is not the untrusted part. It records the gravity-torque curve over each joint's range. The 6 unlimited hinges are skipped, not invented: the thoracolumbar and cervicothoracic hinges are the template's bare joints. The shoulder adduction limit is a deliberate zero (pose-dependent, a placeholder in the sheet), so that side of the shoulder abduction-adduction range has no width. Sweeping one joint at a time is near-worst, not a bound, for a proximal joint whose distal pose matters.
